blocks.text: Thai actor Mario Maurer, who originally played Mak in the 2013 Thai horror-comedy film “Pee Mak,” has expressed his support for the upcoming Philippine adaptation starring Wilbert Ross and Bea Binene. In a videotaped message posted by Viva Films on Instagram Tuesday, Sept. 22, Maurer thanked Filipino audiences for supporting the original movie and congratulated the cast of the local version. “Mabuhay Philippines from Mario Maurer! Thank you for loving our film Pee Mak,” Maurer said. “I want to congratulate Wilbert Ross and the whole cast of the Philippine version of Pee Mak. I know guys that you will do it […]...
